mapper.sql: CONTENT_AD_BANNER_SN, TITLE, SUB_COPY, IMG_URL, POSITION_CD, LINK_TARGET_CD, LINK_TARGET_VAL, EXPOSE_BGN_DATE, EXPOSE_END_DATE, EXPOSE_YN, REG_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_AD_BANNER (TITLE, SUB_COPY, IMG_URL, POSITION_CD, LINK_TARGET_CD, LINK_TARGET_VAL, EXPOSE_BGN_DATE, EXPOSE_END_DATE, EXPOSE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN) VALUES (#{title}, #{subCopy}, #{imgUrl}, #{positionCd}, #{linkTargetCd}, #{linkTargetVal}, #{exposeBgnDate}, #{exposeEndDate}, #{exposeYn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn})
mapper.select: SELECT B.CONTENT_AD_BANNER_SN, B.TITLE, B.SUB_COPY, B.IMG_URL, B.POSITION_CD, B.LINK_TARGET_CD, B.LINK_TARGET_VAL, B.EXPOSE_BGN_DATE, B.EXPOSE_END_DATE, B.EXPOSE_YN, B.REG_DT FROM CONTENT_AD_BANNER B LEFT JOIN COMM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'AD_BANNER_POSITION' AND C.CD = B.POSITION_CD AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE B.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC, B.CONTENT_AD_BANNER_SN DESC
SELECT FROM CONTENT_AD_BANNER WHERE CONTENT_AD_BANNER_SN = #{contentAdBannerSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_AD_BANNER SET TITLE = #{title}, SUB_COPY = #{subCopy}, IMG_URL = #{imgUrl}, POSITION_CD = #{positionCd}, LINK_TARGET_CD = #{linkTargetCd}, LINK_TARGET_VAL = #{linkTargetVal}, EXPOSE_BGN_DATE = #{exposeBgnDate}, EXPOSE_END_DATE = #{exposeEndDate}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE CONTENT_AD_BANNER_SN = #{contentAdBannerSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
